header: Six ways to reach us, all ending with the same people
subheader: There is no first-line team that passes you on. Whoever picks up has installed a till.
lead: If the counter has stopped, ring. Everything else is usually faster by email, because we can look back through what happened before you write.
note: On 24 and 31 December the line is staffed until noon. On other public holidays it is not staffed at all.
